entities.name: Lathril
entities.description: Elf queen from ancient times who became the blind Einir of Kaldheim after giving her sight for godhood.

entities.name: Sarulf
entities.description: Wolf whose kidnapped child Lathril saved and who blessed her people.

entities.name: Kit
entities.description: Little wolf, Sarulf's child, kidnapped and saved by Lathril.

entities.name: Lukya
entities.description: Copper wolf, daughter of Sarulf, who guided Lathril and then accompanied her.

entities.name: Jaspera trees
entities.description: Trees in which some elves believe Lathril's consciousness lingers.

events.summary: Lathril battles Eidermaw and ascends to godhood.
events.quote: later ascent to godhood after her battle with a mysterious Cosmos monster

events.summary: Lathril rescues Sarulf's kidnapped child Kit, guided by Lukya through an Omenpath.
Sarulf blesses Lathril and her people and Lukya decides to accompany Lathril.
events.quote: Lukya also decided to accompany Lathril after saving her brother Kit.

relations.quote: a copper wolf, daughter of Sarulf
Lukya also decided to accompany Lathril
